headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: ALO (9)

summary: Oscar Piastri won the Spanish Grand Prix from pole position, 2.5s ahead of Lando Norris, with Charles Leclerc completing the podium.
Nico Hulkenberg made the biggest climb, from P15 to P5.
Max Verstappen had a day to forget, dropping from P3 to P10.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car.
The stewards penalised ALB (10 second time penalty), BEA (10 second time penalty) and VER (10 second time penalty).
There were 54 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 3 times.
Oscar Piastri leads the championship by 10 points over Lando Norris.
